name: Imaginary Spectacle Parade
source:
The Imaginary Spectacle Parade is the story of a young man who has experienced something very spectacular from an ordinary amusement park.

[From [url=https://nobii.itch.io/imaginary-spectacle-parade]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《奇想奇觀大遊行》講述一名年輕人在平凡的遊樂園裡，經歷了一件極不平凡的事。
